qa_pairs.question: Who is Mikhail Aslanovich Pogosyan?
qa_pairs.context: Mikhail Aslanovich Pogosyan is the rector of MAI, the main person in the entire university. Please answer in English.
qa_pairs.ground_truth: Mikhail Aslanovich Pogosyan is the rector of MAI, a Russian aircraft designer and entrepreneur, academician of the Russian Academy of Sciences (2011), Doctor of Technical Sciences.

qa_pairs.question: Is lunch free?

qa_pairs.ground_truth: MAI does not provide free meals for students, but there is an opportunity to purchase food in the cafeteria at a reasonable price.

qa_pairs.question: Where should I enroll to not regret it?

qa_pairs.ground_truth: For the right choice of direction at MAI, it is recommended to: 1. Assess your interests and inclinations towards technical sciences (physics, mathematics, computer science). 2. Study the training programs at different MAI faculties. 3. Visit open house days. 4. Talk to students of chosen directions. 5. Contact the admissions committee for consultation.

qa_pairs.ground_truth: Family scholarship is not provided at MAI. Students can only receive academic or social scholarships on general terms.

qa_pairs.question: How are the dormitories?
qa_pairs.context: MAI has several dormitories for students. Please answer in English.
qa_pairs.ground_truth: MAI provides dormitory places for non-resident students. Dormitories are located within walking distance from academic buildings. Living conditions are comfortable. But this comfort depends on USE scores or internal exam results.

qa_pairs.question: Is the teaching good?
qa_pairs.context: MAI has a highly qualified teaching staff and modern material and technical base. Please answer in English.
qa_pairs.ground_truth: MAI is one of the leading technical universities in Russia with a high level of teaching. Classes are conducted by experienced teachers, many of whom are active specialists in the aviation and space industry.

qa_pairs.question: How many classes per day?
qa_pairs.context: The class schedule is formed taking into account the specifics of each area of study. Please answer in English.
qa_pairs.ground_truth: The class schedule depends on the course and specialty, usually 2-3 classes per day.

qa_pairs.question: Is it difficult to combine work and study?
qa_pairs.context: The university provides opportunities for combining study and work. Please answer in English.
qa_pairs.ground_truth: Combining work and study requires proper time and effort planning, as the subjects studied at the university are very complex and require a lot of time and effort to learn. Many MAI students successfully combine work with study, however, this may require additional effort and self-discipline.

qa_pairs.question: What is the minimum score needed for admission to faculty 8?
qa_pairs.context: Faculty 8 of MAI is one of the most popular, so the competition is very high. Please answer in English.
qa_pairs.ground_truth: Minimum scores for admission to faculty 8 average 220-280 points for three USE subjects. Specific passing scores may vary depending on the competition and number of applications.
